theorems.name: Submission.c1_sard_coarea_jacobian_continuousOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M → ContinuousOn (coareaJacobian M f) M ∧ ∀ y : Rn m, ∃ F : Set (Rn N), IsClosed F ∧ M ∩ f ⁻¹' {y} ∩ {x | coareaJacobian M f x = 0} = M ∩ F
